title: Order
description: A trading order in the Tent of Trials market engine. Defines a request to buy or sell an instrument with specific parameters.

id.description: Unique order identifier assigned by the exchange

client_order_id.description: Client-specified order identifier for external tracking

price.description: Order price as a decimal string (empty string for market orders)

stop_price.description: Stop price for stop orders (omitted for non-stop orders)

quantity.description: Ordered quantity as a decimal string

filled_quantity.description: Quantity that has been filled so far

leaves_quantity.description: Quantity still open in the order book

time_in_force.description: Time-in-force policy: GTC (good till cancelled), IOC (immediate or cancel), FOK (fill or kill), GTD (good till date)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the order was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the order was last updated

expire_at.description: Expiration timestamp for GTD orders (null if not applicable)

iceberg_quantity.description: Total iceberg quantity (omitted for non-iceberg orders)

display_quantity.description: Visible quantity on the order book for iceberg orders
